title: Re-Opening AEOI Portal to Facilitate Amendments or Corrections of CRS and FATCA
text:
Barbados Revenue Authority Newsroom
Tuesday, October 21, 2025


 bramail@bra.gov.bb
 +1 (246) 429-ETAX (3829)



 📢 The Barbados Revenue Authority (“the Authority”) has re-opened the Automatic Exchange of Information (AEOI) web portal to facilitate amendments and/or corrections of Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and the Common Reporting Standard prior year reports.
🔹 The AEOI web portal is available from Monday, October 20 until Friday, November 14, 2025. Reporting Barbados Financial Institutions (“RBFIs”) are asked to use this time to make any required FATCA and CRS prior year amendments and/or corrections.
Please submit any queries or correspondence regarding this Guidance Note to the Authority’s Global Relations Unit via email at compauth@bra.gov.bb.
Download the official Guidance Note here.
